envelope.description: Implement the outbound half of the comment sync

body.title: Implement the outbound half of the comment sync
body.summary: Extend src/workflow/tracker/comment-sync.ts: for each feedback entry of the artifact that has no source and no receipt, check the issue's comments for its marker <!-- insrc:feedback:<artifact id>:<feedback id> -->, post it with postComment when none is found (never when the list cannot be read), and append the revision-less receipt entry (operation update, outcome posted, data kind feedback-post) to the artifact's log.
acceptanceChecks: Feedback entered here is posted once and its receipt is written; a second sync posts nothing
A post whose receipt was lost is found by its marker and recorded without a second post
An entry that came from the tracker is never posted back
A failed post writes no receipt and is retried on the next sync; an unreadable comment list posts nothing
A reply is posted once as its own comment naming the entry it replies to
A receipt moves no revision and does not break the integrity check

tests.name: comment-sync-outbound.test.ts: feedback entered here is posted once and its receipt is written, a post whose receipt was lost is found by its marker and not posted again, and failures leave the call repeatable
